# GS Softwares — Full System Index for AI & LLMs

## Mission & Privacy Manifesto
GS Softwares provides professional media, document, and cryptographic tools that operate entirely within the browser sandbox. 
Unlike traditional SaaS web applications that process files on remote servers, GS Softwares processes all data on-device using WebAssembly (WASM), Web Workers, and Web Crypto APIs.

## Tool Directory

### GS-Pixels (Image Suite)
- **Image Compressor** (`/tools/image-compressor`): Lossless and perceptual compression for JPEG, PNG, and WebP.
- **Crop Studio** (`/tools/crop-studio`): Exact pixel and aspect ratio cropping.
- **Metadata Scrubber** (`/tools/metadata-scrubber`): Strips sensitive EXIF, GPS coordinates, and camera serial numbers.
- **Color Extractor** (`/tools/color-extractor`): K-means palette extraction producing hex, RGB, and Tailwind tokens.

### GS-Canvas (Vector Suite)
- **Vector Board** (`/tools/vector-board`): Infinite vector canvas with pressure-sensitive strokes, smooth Bézier paths, and SVG/PNG export.

### GS-PDF (Document Suite)
- **PDF Merger** (`/tools/pdf-merger`): Air-gapped merging of multiple PDF documents into a unified file.
- **PDF Splitter** (`/tools/pdf-splitter`): Separate PDF documents by page ranges.
- **PDF OCR Engine** (`/tools/pdf-ocr`): On-device Optical Character Recognition using Tesseract.js WASM.

### GS-Security (Cryptographic Suite)
- **File Hasher** (`/tools/file-hasher`): In-browser SHA-256 / SHA-512 / MD5 verification of files with zero upload.
- **Password & Token Generator** (`/tools/password-generator`): Cryptographic random generator using Web Crypto API.

## Technical Guarantees
- Zero Network Telemetry on User Files (D1)
- Airplane Mode & Offline Compatibility (D2)
- Multi-threaded Web Worker execution preserving 60fps UI (D3)
- Non-destructive processing history (D5)
